# ContextMenu { #anylumino.astryx.ContextMenu }

```python
ContextMenu(
    items,
    children=None,
    *,
    size=None,
    menu_width=None,
    disabled=False,
    action_callbacks=None,
    **props,
)
```

Attach a right-click menu to child widgets.

Menu items dispatch to Python the same way :class:`DropdownMenu` items do,
through ``on_action`` and ``last_action``.

JupyterLab installs its own context menu on notebook outputs, so a right
click inside Lab opens both menus. Prefer :class:`DropdownMenu` or
:class:`MoreMenu` for a notebook-facing menu, and reach for this one when
the output is embedded somewhere Lab does not claim the event.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                                          | Default    |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items            | Iterable\[Any\]                                                | Menu item records. Each item takes a ``label`` and a ``value``, and may set ``disabled`` or ``{"type": "divider"}``. | _required_ |
| children         | ChildInput                                                     | The widgets that respond to a right click.                                                                           | `None`     |
| size             | str \| None                                                    | Menu item size.                                                                                                      | `None`     |
| menu_width       | int \| None                                                    | Fixed menu width in pixels.                                                                                          | `None`     |
| disabled         | bool                                                           | Whether the menu is suppressed.                                                                                      | `False`    |
| action_callbacks | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget, Any\], None\]\] \| None | Python callbacks receiving the chosen item value.                                                                    | `None`     |
| **props          | Any                                                            | JSON-safe ContextMenu props forwarded to Astryx.                                                                     | `{}`       |
| See              |                                                                |                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
